verdict.rationale: A state agency could plausibly publish a public data API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no published endpoints, key-issuance path, or rate limits. The docs cover only web-portal (EAMS/SAW) and paper filing, and every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
